# Verse sound effects: sources and licenses

Every file in this folder is cut, layered, level-matched and encoded (Opus in
Ogg, mono) from recordings released under **CC0 1.0 (public domain
dedication)**: <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>. CC0 asks
for no attribution; the authors are credited here anyway, with thanks. The
license of each source was checked on its own page.
